articles.titleCn: 可读性、忠实性、已使用性：语言模型中人口统计身份的三个可分离属性
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型被广泛用于模拟调查受访者，但其回答同质化且未能真实反映现实中的群体间差异。我们探究了人口群体身份在大型语言模型中的体现方式，其几何结构如何真实映射现实中的群体间意见结构，以及模型是否利用了其编码的信息。通过对Pew的169个人口统计单元的真实数据进行代表性相似度分析，我们在Mistral-7B模型中评估了1,089个读出位置，并在六种属性类型中进行因果干预。得出四项结果。(1)标准的最后一个token残差读出低估了模型：在六种类型中的五种，注意力头读出占主导地位，选择校正后的保真度高达rho=0.63——约相当于测量可靠性上限的70%——在词汇相似度控制下依然保持。(2)单个头（L11 H16）在所有六种类型中作为固定位置表现出显著保真度，而基于种族的类型保真度较弱且对提示敏感。这两种现象在第二模型家族的三个检查点中均得到验证——类似头在六种类型中的五种中显著，在相同种族类型上最弱——十亿个训练token几乎未改变映射结构。(3)因果使用并不遵循保真度：最清晰的因果路径位于最不保真的类型之一（p=0.002，聚类稳健，固定深度），最保真的类型未显示出校正后单层效应，而替换整个身份仅使预测误差变化不到2%。(4)对单个头的128维探针比模型的回答更接近调查真相21-31%，但几乎未能恢复每道题目的群体排序，与模型自身回答相比并无优势。可读性、保真排列和因果使用是同一模型的三种可分离属性；将它们视为单一主张是导致"大型语言模型能否模拟人口"的争论悬而未决的原因。

articles.title: Gradient Mirage: Trainable yet Label-Unidentifiable Gradients in Large Language Model Split Learning
articles.abstract: Gradient matching attacks (GMAs) in LLM split learning (SL) rely on a critical yet underexplored assumption: the gradient exposed at the split interface is a faithful derivative of the client's full-label training objective. This gradient-objective consistency allows a curious server to recover private labels by searching for a sequence whose induced gradient explains the observation. We propose Gradient Mirage, a defense that breaks this consistency without discarding the optimization utility of the backward signal. Our key idea is to induce the adversary to solve a misspecified inverse problem, in which no plausible label sequence in the sequence space can explain the observed gradients. Concretely, Gradient Mirage achieves this by inducing inconsistency across three dimensions: objective, direction, and scale. Selective Autoregressive Supervision derives the exposed gradient from a masked surrogate loss rather than the full-label objective assumed by the attacker; Scale Blinding then applies randomized multiplicative rescaling, obscuring the gradient's natural magnitude; and Directional Privatization further randomizes the gradient direction while preserving its magnitude through the von Mises-Fisher (vMF) mechanism under a directional metric differential privacy guarantee. Crucially, utility is preserved: the Top segment still learns from all target tokens via Dual-Track Backpropagation, the exposed gradient remains informative since each supervised token retains its complete autoregressive context, and Bottom-Gradient Recovery restores the effective gradient for Bottom-segment optimization. Extensive experiments show that Gradient Mirage provides substantially stronger protection than existing defenses under comparable fine-tuning performance, achieving a better privacy-utility trade-off.
articles.titleCn: 梯度幻影：在大型语言模型拆分学习中可训练但无法识别标签的梯度
articles.abstractCn: 在LLM分片学习（SL）中的梯度匹配攻击（GMAs）依赖于一个关键但尚未充分探索的假设：分片界面暴露的梯度是客户端全标签训练目标的忠实导数。这种梯度-目标一致性允许好奇的服务器通过搜索能够解释观察到的梯度的序列来恢复私有标签。我们提出了梯度幻象（Gradient Mirage），这是一种在不丢弃反向信号优化效用的情况下打破这种一致性的防御方法。我们的核心思想是诱导攻击者解决一个错误指定的逆问题，其中序列空间中没有任何合理的标签序列能够解释观察到的梯度。具体而言，梯度幻象通过在三个维度上诱导不一致性来实现这一点：目标、方向和尺度。选择性自回归监督（Selective Autoregressive Supervision）从掩码代理损失而非攻击者假设的全标签目标中推导出暴露的梯度；尺度屏蔽（Scale Blinding）随后应用随机乘法重缩放，掩盖梯度的自然幅度；方向私有化（Directional Privatization）进一步通过在方向度量差分隐私（directional metric differential privacy）保证下，通过冯·米塞斯-费希尔（vMF）机制随机化梯度方向，同时保留其幅度。关键在于，效用得到了保留：Top片段仍然通过双轨反向传播（Dual-Track Backpropagation）从所有目标token中学习，暴露的梯度仍然是信息量丰富的，因为每个受监督的token都保留了其完整的自回归上下文，而Bottom-Gradient Recovery恢复了用于Bottom片段优化的有效梯度。大量实验表明，与现有防御相比，梯度幻象在相当细调性能下提供了更强的保护，实现了更好的隐私-效用权衡。

articles.title: Learning Canonical Register Automata over Ordered Data Domains
articles.abstract: Register automata are finite automata equipped with memory that recognize data languages over infinite alphabets. In this work, we investigate active learning algorithms for deterministic register automata (DRAs) over ordered data domains--covering both dense domains, such as the rationals, and non-dense domains such as the integers. We show that the active learning problem for DRAs over both dense and non-dense ordered domains can be treated within a single unified framework. More specifically, we develop and implement a polynomial-time active learning procedure for DRAs over ordered domains, using oracles for membership, equivalence and memorability queries. The memorability queries were originally introduced for learning DRAs over domains with identity tests. Our unified framework also leads to a new consequence: minimization of DRAs over the non-dense ordered domain of integers is decidable, extending a result previously known only for dense domains. Finally, we give improved complexity bounds of several decision problems for DRAs over ordered domains that are closely related to the queries used in active learning.
articles.titleCn: 学习有序数据域上的规范寄存器自动机
articles.abstractCn: 寄存器自动机是带有存储器的有限自动机，用于识别无限字母表上的数据语言。在本工作中，我们研究了有序数据域上确定性寄存器自动机（DRA）的主动学习算法——涵盖了包括有理数在内的密集域以及整数等非密集域。我们证明了有序密集域和非密集域上DRA的主动学习问题可以在一个统一的框架内处理。更具体地说，我们开发并实现了一种针对有序域上DRA的多项式时间主动学习过程，使用预言机进行成员资格、等价性和可记忆性查询。可记忆性查询最初是为学习具有身份测试域上的DRA而引入的。我们的统一框架还导致了一个新结论：整数非密集有序域上DRA的最小化问题是可判定的，这一结果此前仅在密集域中已知。最后，我们给出了与主动学习中使用的查询密切相关的一些决策问题在有序域上DRA的改进复杂度界限。

articles.title: GreekBarRetrieval: A Benchmark for Greek Statutory Retrieval
articles.abstract: Statutory retrieval is necessary for citation-grounded legal question answering, but remains underexplored for Greek. We introduce GreekBarRetrieval, a public retrieval benchmark derived from, and complementing GreekBarBench, which did not include retrieval. The new benchmark comprises 283 bar-exam questions, each accompanied by the facts of the case it refers to, and 6,308 candidate statutory articles to retrieve from. Questions and facts are stated in everyday language, but need to be mapped to the formal terminology of statutes and their abstract legal concepts. A further complication is that not all of the case facts are relevant to each question of a case. Experimenting with three BM25 variants and nine dense retrievers, we find that vanilla dense retrieval far outperforms vanilla sparse retrieval in Recall@100. However, LLM-based query reformulation helps BM25 close that gap, while also improving dense retrieval. With a ten-round ReAct-like LLM reformulation loop that we introduce, BM25 improves further in Recall@100 and obtains the best nDCG and MAP scores of all tested retrievers. Query reformulation also outperforms pseudo-relevance feedback, sparse-dense fusion, and English translation.

articles.titleCn: 希腊法律检索基准：希腊法规检索基准
articles.abstractCn: 在基于引用的法律问题回答中，法定检索是必要的，但对于希腊语而言，这一领域仍待深入探索。我们介绍了GreekBarRetrieval，这是一个公开的检索基准，源于GreekBarBench，后者并未包含检索部分。新的基准包含283个律师资格考试问题，每个问题都附有它所指的案件事实，以及6,308个可供检索的候选法定条文。问题和事实使用日常语言表述，但需要映射到法规及其抽象法律概念的形式术语。进一步的复杂性在于，并非所有案件事实都与每个案件的问题相关。通过测试三种BM25变体和九种密集检索器，我们发现原版密集检索在Recall@100上远优于原版稀疏检索。然而，基于LLM的查询重写有助于BM25缩小这一差距，同时也提升了密集检索的性能。通过我们引入的十轮ReAct式LLM重写循环，BM25在Recall@100上进一步改进，并获得了所有测试检索器中最佳的nDCG和MAP分数。查询重写也优于伪相关反馈、稀疏-密集融合以及英语翻译。

articles.title: Metrics That Write Themselves: Evolving an Evaluator from Its Own Blind Spots
articles.abstract: Agents improve quickly against a reliable automatic metric and stall without one, and the applications that need them most, report generation among them, are the ones nobody knows how to score. Can the metric write itself? Saying what makes an answer good is hard; pointing at something wrong with one is easier, so the metric we evolve is a pool of small Python operators that each flag a candidate for one named defect, or abstain, and vote. Asking a model for operators directly does not work: 183 candidates realise only 96 distinct behaviours, from one narrow region of an enormous space. EvalCEGAR instead borrows counterexample-guided abstraction refinement from program verification. It reads the pool as an abstraction and searches for a collision, two answers the operators score identically, one correct and one not. That pair, not a prompt, is the authoring request, and when a collision defeats every attempt the loop widens what an operator may read rather than resampling. On MBPP+ and HumanEval+, a sandbox whose hidden unit tests give exact ground truth, the loop writes a 55-line operator that closes 15.4% of the gap between flagging nothing and a perfect filter on 428 unseen tasks (+0.0065, p=0.0010) at a quarter of our best hand-written operator's flags. On the benchmark it never saw it matches that operator's effect exactly on a third of the flags. Six of eight runs admit such an operator and all six help out of sample; our 15 hand-written operators applied together as one filter lose accuracy. An LLM judge on the same information ties that delta on a nearly disjoint set of candidates, and charges a model call per candidate forever where the operator charges none.
articles.titleCn: 自动生成的指标：从一个评估器的盲点进化而来
articles.abstractCn: 代理在可靠的自动指标面前能快速改进，而没有指标则停滞不前，而最需要这些代理的应用，如报告生成，却是那些无人知晓如何评分的领域。指标能否自我编写？说明一个答案为何优秀很难，指出其错误则容易，因此我们进化出的指标是一个包含小型Python操作符的集合，每个操作符标记一个特定缺陷的候选答案，或弃权，并进行投票。直接向模型索取操作符行不通：183个候选者仅表现出96种不同行为，仅来自巨大空间中的一个狭窄区域。EvalCEGAR则借鉴了程序验证中的反例引导抽象精炼方法。它将操作符集合视为一个抽象概念，并搜索碰撞，即两个操作符评分完全相同的答案，一个正确，一个错误。这对答案，而非提示，就是创作请求，当碰撞击败所有尝试时，循环会扩展操作符可能读取的内容，而不是重新采样。在MBPP+和HumanEval+上，一个隐藏单元测试提供精确真实值的沙盒中，循环编写了一个55行的操作符，在428个未见过的任务上，从标记无任何缺陷到完美过滤之间缩小了15.4%的差距（+0.0065，p=0.0010），仅使用我们最佳手写操作符四分之一的标记。在基准测试中，它从未见过这个操作符，但在三分之一的情况下与操作符的效果完全匹配。八次运行中有六次承认这样的操作符，并且所有六次都在样本外提供帮助；我们15个手写操作符合在一起作为一个过滤器会降低精度。在相同信息上的LLM裁判在几乎不重叠的候选集上打平了这个差距，并且对每个候选者永久调用模型，而操作符则不收费。

articles.title: Execution-grounded evaluation reveals hidden failures in language-model calculations for environmental science
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used for quantitative work in the environmental sciences, yet existing evaluations score only final answers, leaving calculation process unobserved. Here we introduce AtmosCoder-Bench, an execution-grounded benchmark that makes the calculation process visible. Built through a transferable semi-automated pipeline (436 problems, 3,910 variants, 7,029 graded quantities), every problem is validated to be unambiguous and human-solvable, with uniquely verifiable answers. We find that (i) multiple-choice formats inflate measured accuracy by at least 12 percentage points; (ii) many failures arise not from missing knowledge but from models failing to apply known formulas and constraints consistently throughout multi-step computation; and (iii) even frontier models remain weak when task-specific conditions invalidate familiar methods, often reverting to canonical solution patterns rather than adapting methods to the relevant physical regime, leaving expert oversight essential.
articles.comment: 29 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables, plus supplementary materials. Maohao Ran and Chendong Ma contributed equally. Corresponding author: Jun Song (junsong@hkbu.edu.hk). Code: https://github.com/acodercat/AtmosCoder-Bench
articles.titleCn: 基于实际执行的评估揭示了环境科学中语言模型计算中隐藏的失败。
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在环境科学领域的定量工作中应用日益广泛，然而现有的评估方法仅评分最终答案，计算过程未被观察。在此，我们引入AtmosCoder-Bench，一个基于执行过程的基准，使计算过程可视化。通过可迁移的半自动化流程（包含436个问题、3,910个变体、7,029个分级量），每个问题均经过验证，确保其无歧义且人类可解决，并具有唯一可验证的答案。我们发现：(i) 选择题格式至少夸大了12个百分点的测量准确率；(ii) 许多失败并非源于知识缺失，而是模型未能在整个多步计算过程中始终如一地应用已知公式和约束；(iii) 即使是前沿模型，在任务特定条件使熟悉方法失效时仍表现薄弱，往往退回到标准解决方案模式而非调整方法以适应相关物理环境，这使得专家监督至关重要。

articles.title: Budget-First Tariff Recommendation (BFTR): A Complete Algorithmic Framework for Telecom Plan Recommendation without Overcharging
articles.abstract: Telecom operators traditionally offer predefined tariff grids, forcing users to choose from a limited set of plans. This paper proposes BFTR (Budget-First Tariff Recommendation), a complete algorithmic framework integrating eight Budget-First strategies, including two original hybrid approaches: Recursive Hybrid (conditional interpolation) and Knapsack-First Hybrid (priority knapsack). Unlike existing approaches that adjust prices upward to guarantee a minimum margin, BFTR guarantees the absence of overcharging by systematically aligning the final price with the catalog reference price. We mathematically formalize each strategy, prove the existence of an offer for any positive budget, and prove that the price deviation (surcharge) is zero for all strategies that do not use interpolation with correction. A detailed comparative analysis confronts BFTR to ten main existing tariff models on ten dimensions. Experiments on a dataset of 974 customers inspired by the Nigerian MTN market show that: (i) Recursive Hybrid is optimal for the customer (100% budget used, 29.9 GB volume, utility 0.946, 0% overcharging), (ii) Piecewise offers the highest volume (39.7 GB) with 0% overcharging, (iii) Power Law provides an excellent compromise (99.9% budget, 38.1 GB, 0% overcharging). All strategies achieve a zero surcharge, confirming the theoretical guarantees. A sensitivity analysis on the weighting parameter alpha (0.2 - volume priority, 0.5 - balance, 0.8 - budget priority) shows that utility rankings evolve logically. Execution times (< 10 ms) and very low failure rates (0% for robust strategies) confirm the operational viability of the system. The formal proof of the absence of overcharging constitutes a major theoretical contribution.

articles.titleCn: 预算优先费率推荐（BFTR）：一种用于电信套餐推荐且无超额收费的完整算法框架
articles.abstractCn: 电信运营商传统上提供预定义的费率表，迫使用户从有限的一组套餐中进行选择。本文提出了BFTR（预算优先费率推荐），这是一个完整的算法框架，集成了八种预算优先策略，包括两种原创的混合方法：递归混合（条件插值）和背包优先混合（优先背包）。与现有方法通过向上调整价格来保证最低利润不同，BFTR通过系统地使最终价格与目录参考价格保持一致来保证不会过度收费。我们对每种策略进行了数学形式化，证明了对于任何正预算都存在报价，并证明了不使用插值校正的所有策略的价格偏差（附加费）为零。详细的比较分析在十个维度上对比了BFTR和十个主要的现有费率模型。基于尼日利亚MTN市场灵感的数据集（974名客户）的实验表明：(i)递归混合对客户最优（100%预算使用，29.9 GB流量，效用0.946，0%过度收费），(ii)分段报价提供最高流量（39.7 GB），且无过度收费，(iii)幂律提供了一个极佳的折中方案（99.9%预算，38.1 GB，0%过度收费）。所有策略均实现零附加费，验证了理论保证。对权重参数alpha（0.2-流量优先，0.5-平衡，0.8-预算优先）的敏感性分析表明效用排名逻辑演变。执行时间（<10 ms）和极低的失败率（稳健策略为0%）证实了系统的实际可行性。无过度收费的正式证明构成了重要的理论贡献。

articles.title: MemFuse: Multi-Source Memory Fusion from Fragmented Observations
articles.abstract: Long-term memory is essential for agents that operate across extended interactions, yet existing memory systems and benchmarks predominantly focus on single-source textual histories. In realistic settings, however, relevant information is often fragmented across applications and devices, as well as across users and time, requiring agents to integrate dispersed observations into coherent episodic memories while preserving their source provenance. To address these gaps, we introduce **MemFuseBench**, a benchmark for *multi-source memory fusion*. MemFuseBench is built with a Scene-to-Sensor pipeline that synthesizes controllable scenarios into source-tagged observations, evidence-grounded questions, and adversarial distractors. It enables systematic evaluation of temporal reasoning, cross-source evidence fusion, and robustness to noise. We further propose **MemFuse**, a structured memory system that preserves source-level evidence in event-layer atomic memory and organizes related atomic events into cluster-layer fused memory within a causal fusion graph. During retrieval, MemFuse retrieves and organizes related evidence fragments while maintaining traceability to original source events. Experiments on MemFuseBench show that MemFuse achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated memory systems under all three LLM settings and consistently improves performance on questions requiring cross-source evidence fusion.

articles.titleCn: MemFuse：基于碎片化观测的多源记忆融合
articles.abstractCn: 长期记忆对于跨长时间交互的智能体至关重要，然而现有的记忆系统和基准测试主要集中于单源文本历史。但在现实场景中，相关信息往往分散在不同应用、设备、用户以及时间维度上，需要智能体将分散的观察结果整合为连贯的情景记忆，同时保留其来源信息。为解决这些不足，我们提出了**MemFuseBench**，一个用于*多源记忆融合*的基准测试。MemFuseBench基于场景到传感器的流水线，将可控场景合成带源标签的观察结果、基于证据的问题以及对抗性干扰项。它支持对时间推理、跨源证据融合以及抗噪声能力的系统性评估。此外，我们还提出了**MemFuse**，一种结构化记忆系统，它在事件层原子记忆中保留源级证据，并在因果融合图中将相关原子事件组织成簇层融合记忆。在检索过程中，MemFuse能够检索并组织相关证据片段，同时保持对原始源事件的可追溯性。在MemFuseBench上的实验表明，在所有三种LLM设置下，MemFuse在所评估的记忆系统中表现最佳，并且始终提升需要跨源证据融合的问题的性能。

articles.title: Aslema at NADI 2026: Data Augmentation for Intent Recognition and Slot Filling
articles.abstract: We present Aslema, our system for NADI 2026 Shared Task 5, which consists of two subtasks: intent recognition and slot filling. We evaluate four omni LLMs in a zero-shot setting and compare them with fine-tuned models. Our results show that fine-tuning consistently outperforms zero-shot inference. We further explore synthetic data augmentation by using an LLM to generate culturally grounded Tunisian Derja utterances, followed by voice cloning to generate synthetic speech. Incorporating this synthetic data improves performance on both tasks. Our final submitted system, based on Qwen3-Omni-30B and trained with a mixture of original and synthetic data, achieves 86.8% intent accuracy and 34.7 WER on the devtest split. On the official test set it ranks 1st in slot filling (59.5 CoER) and 4th among 8 teams in intent recognition (66.1% accuracy). We release our experimental scripts and will soon share the synthetic dataset to support further research in this area.

articles.titleCn: NADI 2026上的Aslema：用于意图识别和槽填充的数据增强
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了为NADI 2026共享任务5设计的Aslema系统，该系统包含两个子任务：意图识别和槽位填充。我们在零样本设置下评估了四种全功能大语言模型，并将它们与微调模型进行了比较。我们的结果表明，微调始终优于零样本推理。我们进一步探索了通过使用大语言模型生成具有文化背景的突尼斯Derja语句，然后进行语音克隆以生成合成语音的合成数据增强方法。将这种合成数据纳入其中提高了两个任务的性能。我们的最终提交系统基于Qwen3-Omni-30B，并使用原始数据和合成数据的混合进行训练，在开发测试集上实现了86.8%的意图准确率和34.7的WER。在官方测试集上，它在槽位填充任务中排名第一（59.5 CoER），在意图识别任务中位列8支队伍中的第4名（66.1%准确率）。我们发布了实验脚本，并将很快分享合成数据集以支持该领域的进一步研究。

articles.title: Learning What to Fail On: Failure-Mode Contextual Bandits for Adversarial Data Curation
articles.abstract: We introduce a failure-aware adversarial retrieval-augmented framework for improving robustness in natural language understanding. Rather than selecting synthetic examples with a fixed reward threshold, our method formulates adversarial data curation as a failure-mode contextual bandit problem. Candidate examples are generated with retrieval-augmented prompting, filtered by the current target model, automatically validated by an LLM judge ensemble, and clustered into recurring failure modes. A stochastic policy then selects which failure modes to sample for retraining, and is updated using validation-based reward that balances robustness gains, forgetting, and data cost. This makes the data curator itself the learning agent, enabling adaptive selection of the most useful model failures across training rounds. On standard benchmarks, our approach improves RoBERTa-base accuracy from 88.48% to 92.60% on SNLI, from 75.04% to 80.95% on ANLI, and from 54.67% to 71.99% on MultiNLI, while consistently outperforming prior adversarial augmentation methods. We further demonstrate transfer to FEVER fact verification, achieving up to 79.86\% FEVER score and 82.45\% accuracy with RoBERTa-large. Finally, we provide a theoretical interpretation showing that, under stated assumptions, failure-mode sampling can reduce shortcut-aligned gradient contributions while inducing bounded distributional drift. By combining retrieval, automated validation, contextual-bandit failure selection, and controlled adversarial retraining, our framework enables scalable robustness improvement without additional human annotation.
articles.titleCn: 学习失败之处：对抗性数据策展的失效模式上下文 bandit
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了一种具有失效感知能力的对抗检索增强框架，用于提升自然语言理解的鲁棒性。与通过固定奖励阈值选择合成样本不同，我们的方法将对抗性数据策展表述为失效模式上下文 bandit 问题。候选样本通过检索增强提示生成，由当前目标模型进行过滤，由大型语言模型（LLM）裁判集成自动验证，并聚类为反复出现的失效模式。随机策略随后选择用于重新训练的失效模式，并使用基于验证的奖励进行更新，该奖励在鲁棒性收益、遗忘和数据成本之间取得平衡。这使得数据策展本身成为学习代理，能够在训练轮次中自适应选择最有用的模型失效。在标准基准测试中，我们的方法将 RoBERTa-base 在 SNLI 上的准确率从 88.48% 提升至 92.60%，在 ANLI 上从 75.04% 提升至 80.95%，在 MultiNLI 上从 54.67% 提升至 71.99%，同时始终优于先前的对抗增强方法。我们进一步展示了在 FEVER 事实验证上的迁移能力，使用 RoBERTa-large 实现了高达 79.86% 的 FEVER 分数和 82.45% 的准确率。最后，我们提供了一个理论解释，表明在给定假设下，失效模式采样可以减少与捷径对齐的梯度贡献，同时引入有界的分布漂移。通过结合检索、自动验证、上下文 bandit 失效选择和受控的对抗性重新训练，我们的框架能够在无需额外人工标注的情况下实现可扩展的鲁棒性提升。

articles.title: X2Streaming-TTS: Causal Token-Level Text-to-Speech from Streaming Text with Speech-State Inheritance
articles.abstract: Streaming text-to-speech is essential for low-latency spoken dialogue systems, yet many systems wait for sentence-level text and are therefore only pseudo-streaming. True token-level synthesis must generate speech from uncertain prefixes while maintaining perceptual continuity over an unbounded stream with bounded context. We present X2Streaming-TTS, a causal TTS framework that consumes asynchronously arriving text tokens and emits speech without accessing future input. To handle uncertain prefixes, we introduce causal commitment, which keeps ambiguous expressions provisional through uncertainty-aware buffering and performs capacity-adaptive, punctuation-aware segmentation. To preserve acoustic continuity, we further introduce causal speech-state inheritance, which carries the complete Code2Wav state and selected historical Talker states across segment boundaries. Together with an attention prior constraint, it blocks access to future positions while retaining bounded acoustic context. Experiments show that X2Streaming-TTS outperforms existing pseudo-streaming models on most subjective and objective metrics. Further analysis shows that causal commitment stabilizes online segmentation and reduces failures caused by insufficient context, while speech-state inheritance improves boundary continuity without degrading naturalness or speaker identity. X2Streaming-TTS thus achieves strict token-level synthesis with quality comparable to the evaluated offline baselines, a median time to first audio token (TTFT) of 15.8 ms for a single request, and a median TTFT of 260.8 ms at 128 concurrent requests. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/X-Square-Robot/X2Streaming-TTS .

articles.titleCn: X2Streaming-TTS：基于流式文本的因果级联语音合成，继承语音状态
articles.abstractCn: 流式文本转语音对于低延迟的语音对话系统至关重要，然而许多系统等待句子级别的文本输入，因此只能实现伪流式处理。真正的标记级合成必须在不依赖未来输入的情况下，从不确定的前缀文本生成语音，同时保持对无限长输入流中感知连续性的控制。我们提出了X2Streaming-TTS，一个因果语音合成框架，该框架异步消费输入的文本标记并输出语音，而无需访问未来的输入。为了处理不确定的前缀，我们引入了因果承诺机制，通过不确定性感知的缓冲机制保持模糊表达为临时状态，并执行容量自适应、标点感知的分段。为了保持声学连续性，我们进一步引入了因果语音状态继承机制，该机制在分段边界处传递完整的Code2Wav状态和选定的历史说话人状态。结合注意力先验约束，它阻止访问未来位置，同时保持有限声学上下文。实验表明，X2Streaming-TTS在大多数主观和客观指标上优于现有的伪流式模型。进一步分析显示，因果承诺机制稳定了在线分段并减少了因上下文不足导致的失败，而语音状态继承机制在提高边界连续性的同时，不会降低自然度或说话人身份。因此，X2Streaming-TTS实现了严格的标记级合成，其质量与评估的离线基线相当，单个请求的中位数首次音频标记生成时间（TTFT）为15.8毫秒，128个并发请求的中位数TTFT为260.8毫秒。我们的实现代码已公开发布在https://github.com/X-Square-Robot/X2Streaming-TTS。

articles.title: Squeezing the Cache, Preserving the Truth: Monotonic Equipotential Allocation with Geodesia-KV
articles.abstract: Current assessment of KV-cache compression performance confuses resident bits with read bandwidth and is affected by the artifacts of chunked teacher-forcing. We present Geodesia-KV, a family of training-free KV cache policies based on monotonic block-wise precision allocation, exact rate-distortion residuals, and query-sparse reading, enabling proper hardware-ready compression. With proper separation of resident and read bits and causal evaluation, we show that Geodesia-KV significantly outperforms other approaches. Specifically, on WikiText-2 with 16k context, the 5-bit operating point of Geodesia-KV results in lower perplexity at lower bitrate than KIVI-4 on Qwen. In addition, our compressed-Quest version delivers improved perplexity and reduces resident (9.83 vs 16.25 bits/value) and read rates (1.95 vs 2.32 bits/value) over baseline sparse methods on PG-19. As Geodesia-KV is implemented as native GeodesiaKVCacheManager plug-in of vLLM, Geodesia-KV fully removes the need for dense cache residency via monotonic bit demotion. With the full consumer hardware evaluation, Geodesia-KV leads to 1M-token context generation on a single 16 GiB GPU with up to 71.7% peak VRAM savings on all leading architectures (Qwen, Llama, DeepSeek).

articles.titleCn: 挤压缓存，保留真相：基于Geodesia-KV的单调等势分配
articles.abstractCn: 当前对KV缓存压缩性能的评估将驻留比特与读取带宽混淆，并受到分块教师强制（chunked teacher-forcing）伪影的影响。我们提出了Geodesia-KV，这是一系列无需训练的KV缓存策略，基于单调块状精度分配、精确率失真残差和查询稀疏读取，实现硬件就绪的压缩。通过合理分离驻留比特和读取比特，并进行因果评估，我们证明Geodesia-KV显著优于其他方法。具体而言，在WikiText-2的16k上下文中，Geodesia-KV的5比特工作点在低于比特率的条件下实现了比Qwen上的KIVI-4更低的困惑度。此外，我们的压缩-Quest版本在PG-19上比基线稀疏方法提高了困惑度，并降低了驻留率（9.83 vs 16.25比特/值）和读取率（1.95 vs 2.32比特/值）。由于Geodesia-KV作为vLLM的原生GeodesiaKVCacheManager插件实现，Geodesia-KV通过单调比特贬低完全消除了对密集缓存驻留的需求。通过全面的消费者硬件评估，Geodesia-KV在所有主流架构（Qwen、Llama、DeepSeek）上，使用单个16 GiB GPU实现了1M-token上下文生成，最高节省了71.7%的峰值VRAM。

articles.title: TranslatePsy-AfriSLM: High-Quality Data Scaling For Low-Resource Machine Translation
articles.abstract: The rapid progress in Artificial Intelligence has largely bypassed African languages, creating a digital divide that limits AI adoption on the continent. Recent open-source LLMs systematically underperform on African language machine translation, while the lack of large-scale, high-quality, open-source parallel data has constrained the development of competitive small language models (SLMs). We introduce TranslatePsy-AfriSLM, a collection of open-source machine translation resources for 19 Sub-Saharan African languages, including curated parallel data, African-specialized synthetic data, and a family of fine-tuned SLMs. Our empirical study shows that unified quality-estimation filtering removes up to 96% of training tokens without degrading quality, and that filtered synthetic data dominates the quality-efficiency Pareto frontier. Fine-tuned on the resulting data mixture, TranslatePsy-AfriSLMs outperform substantially larger systems, including TranslateGemma-27B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, with as few as 0.8B parameters.

articles.titleCn: Psy-AfriSLM：低资源机器翻译的高质量数据扩展
articles.abstractCn: 人工智能的飞速发展在很大程度上忽视了非洲语言，造成了数字鸿沟，限制了该大陆对人工智能的采用。最近的开放源码大型语言模型在非洲语言机器翻译方面系统性地表现不佳，而缺乏大规模、高质量、开放源码的平行数据则限制了具有竞争力的小型语言模型（SLM）的发展。我们介绍了TranslatePsy-AfriSLM，这是一套用于19种撒哈拉以南非洲语言的开放源码机器翻译资源，包括精选的平行数据、非洲专业合成数据以及一系列微调的SLM。我们的实证研究表明，统一的品质评估过滤可去除高达96%的训练令牌，而不会降低质量，并且过滤后的合成数据主导了质量效率的帕累托前沿。在由此产生的数据混合上微调，TranslatePsy-AfriSLM在参数量仅为0.8B的情况下，大幅优于TranslateGemma-27B和Qwen3.5-122B-A10B等更大规模的系统。

articles.title: When Safety Overrides Vision: Exploring Dynamics between Vision Influence and Safety Alignment in Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Aligned vision-language models (VLMs) are designed to balance grounded visual reasoning with safe generation behavior. However, we observe a striking phenomenon: under safety-constrained instruction, models frequently abstain from answering questions that remain correctly answerable under default instruction despite receiving identical image-question inputs. This raises a fundamental question: does safety alignment suppress perceptual grounding itself, or does visual evidence remain internally available while generation is redirected toward abstention? In this work, we investigate the internal decoding dynamics underlying safety-induced abstention in aligned VLMs. Across multiple architectures and multimodal benchmarks, we show that abstained generations remain consistently influenced by visual evidence throughout decoding, indicating that perceptual grounding is largely preserved despite refusal behavior. We further demonstrate that, although the representational organization of refusal differs substantially across architectures, safety-constrained instruction consistently alters late-stage hidden-state dynamics toward refusal-oriented decoding. Finally, through targeted activation-level interventions, we show that suppressing refusal-related representations reliably restores grounded answering behavior across models without retraining or modifying visual inputs. Together, these findings reveal a previously underexplored failure mode in aligned VLMs: safety alignment can override grounded visual expression even when perceptual evidence remains internally preserved.
articles.titleCn: 当安全覆盖视觉：探索视觉影响与安全对齐在视觉语言模型中的动态关系
articles.abstractCn: 对齐的视觉语言模型（VLMs）旨在平衡基于视觉的推理与安全的生成行为。然而，我们观察到一种显著现象：在安全约束指令下，模型在接收相同图像-问题输入时，频繁地放弃回答那些在默认指令下本可以正确回答的问题。这引发了一个基本问题：安全对齐是否抑制了感知接地本身，抑或是视觉证据虽然内部可用，但生成过程被重定向为放弃？在这项工作中，我们研究了对齐VLMs中安全诱导放弃的内部解码动态。在多种架构和多模态基准测试中，我们发现放弃的生成在整个解码过程中始终受到视觉证据的影响，表明尽管存在拒绝行为，感知接地在很大程度上得以保留。我们进一步证明，尽管拒绝的表征组织在不同架构之间存在显著差异，但安全约束指令始终会改变晚期隐藏状态动态，使其朝向拒绝导向的解码。最后，通过有针对性的激活水平干预，我们表明抑制与拒绝相关的表征可以可靠地恢复模型的基础回答行为，而无需重新训练或修改视觉输入。综合这些发现，揭示了在对齐VLMs中一种此前未被充分探索的失效模式：安全对齐即使感知证据在内部得以保留，也可能覆盖基于视觉的表达。

articles.title: Can a Lightweight Multimodal Model Estimate LLM Reasoning Performance? A Study for Compute-Optimal Document Inference
articles.abstract: Uniformly allocating inference reasoning budgets to LLMs is expensive and prone to over-thinking penalties; especially in document tasks where visual layouts drive complexity. To address this, we introduce BudgetDoc, the first multimodal benchmark providing explicit supervision for model-budget-performance trade-offs across three document tasks. Using BudgetDoc, we train DRB (Document-Reasoning Balancer), an approx. 1B-parameter pre-flight estimator (SigLIP-2 + Qwen3-0.6B) that predicts ordinal model performance across budget levels, achieving a 0.753 weighted F1. When dynamically allocating reasoning budgets across five frontier models and three datasets, DRB matches or improves F1 scores compared to always-maximum-budget baselines in 9 of 15 configurations while drastically reducing cost. Finally, preliminary evaluations demonstrate DRB's potential to generalize to cross-model selection.
articles.titleCn: 轻量级多模态模型能否评估大语言模型的推理性能？一项关于计算最优文档推理的研究
articles.abstractCn: 在大型语言模型（LLMs）中统一分配推理推理预算既昂贵又容易导致过度思考的惩罚；尤其是在文档任务中，视觉布局会驱动复杂性。为解决这一问题，我们引入了BudgetDoc，这是首个提供跨三个文档任务模型-预算-性能权衡显式监督的多模态基准。使用BudgetDoc，我们训练了DRB（文档推理平衡器），这是一个大约1B参数的预评估估计器（SigLIP-2 + Qwen3-0.6B），它预测不同预算水平下的模型性能等级，实现了0.753的加权F1分数。当在五个前沿模型和三个数据集上动态分配推理预算时，DRB在15种配置中的9种配置下与始终使用最大预算的基线相比，匹配或提高了F1分数，同时大幅降低了成本。最后，初步评估表明DRB具有泛化到跨模型选择的能力。

articles.title: From Storage to Access: Verifiable Activation of Parametric Knowledge in LLMs via Explicit Priming and Implicit Reasoning
articles.abstract: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) encode rich factual knowledge in their parameters, reliably recalling and verifying such knowledge remains a key bottleneck in factual question answering. Existing end-to-end methods entangle knowledge elicitation with reasoning, making it difficult to determine whether correct answers arise from parametric knowledge or the input context. To address this challenge, we propose VAKE (Verifiable Activation of Parametric KnowledgE), a two-stage reinforcement-learning framework that externalizes latent parametric knowledge through explicit Priming and transfers the acquired elicitation capability to implicit Reasoning. Given a query and an insufficient retrieved subgraph, the Priming policy explicitly inserts bridging triples as verifiable evidence, with supervision provided by rewards derived from answers generated by a separate frozen model over the augmented subgraph. Building on the policy learned during Priming, the Reasoning stage trains the model to answer from the original input, testing whether the capability acquired through explicit knowledge elicitation transfers to implicit reasoning. Experiments across seven benchmarks and models from 3B to 14B show that VAKE consistently outperforms standard baselines, including when transferring directly from HotpotQA to OOD datasets. LLM-based evaluation further shows that over 80% of the inserted triples provide factual bridging knowledge not derivable from the retrieved context, while more than half elicit knowledge inaccessible through direct prompting. These results suggest that VAKE activates latent parametric knowledge rather than copying the input context or memorizing dataset-specific associations.
articles.titleCn: 从存储到访问：通过显式启动和隐式推理在大型语言模型中验证参数化知识的激活
articles.abstractCn: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在其参数中编码了丰富的知识，但可靠地回忆和验证此类知识仍然是事实性问答中的一个关键瓶颈。现有的端到端方法将知识提取与推理交织在一起，使得难以判断正确答案是否来源于参数化知识或输入上下文。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了VAKE（可验证的参数化知识激活），这是一个两阶段的强化学习框架，通过显式的启动（Priming）将潜在参数化知识外部化，并将获得的知识提取能力转移到隐式的推理（Reasoning）中。给定一个查询和不足够检索到的子图，启动策略会显式插入连接三元组作为可验证的证据，并由一个独立的冻结模型在增强子图上生成的答案提供的奖励进行监督。基于在启动阶段学习的策略，推理阶段训练模型从原始输入中回答，测试通过显式知识提取获得的的能力是否转移到隐式推理。在七个基准和从3B到14B的模型上的实验表明，VAKE始终优于标准基线，包括直接从HotpotQA转移到OOD数据集的情况。基于LLM的评价进一步表明，超过80%插入的三元组提供了无法从检索到的上下文中推导出的事实性连接知识，而超过一半是通过直接提示无法提取的知识。这些结果表明，VAKE激活了潜在的参数化知识，而不是复制输入上下文或记忆数据集特定的关联。

articles.title: Compress and Forget: bitsandbytes Quantization Amplifies Proactive Interference in LLMs
articles.abstract: Proactive interference (PI) is a documented failure mode in large language models in which retrieval of a repeatedly overwritten value degrades as prior overwrites accumulate, mirroring a classical phenomenon in human working memory. Post-training quantization (PTQ) is now the default deployment path for open-weight models, yet its effect on this failure mode has not been tested. We evaluate three precision levels (FP16, INT8, INT4/NF4, via bitsandbytes) across three architecturally distinct instruction-tuned models (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, Phi-3.5-mini-instruct), holding the retrieval task fixed. INT4 quantization significantly reduces accuracy under high interference in every model (e.g., from 81.0% to 68.3% for Qwen), confirmed by paired McNemar's tests ($p \le 2.6 \times 10^{-6}$) and a mixed-effects regression spanning all interference levels; INT8, often assumed safe, also carries a smaller but real penalty in two of three models. The effect is specific to semantically similar (word-type) distractors and reverses sign under a numeric control condition, and is mechanistically linked to a rise in same-key intrusion errors under INT4 (from 21.5% to 24.6% of trials, $p = 4.8 \times 10^{-7}$). A follow-up ablation shows the effect originates in the quantized transformer backbone rather than the output projection layer. These results suggest that bitsandbytes 4-bit quantization can impose an additional cost on applications relying on long, updatable, semantically dense contexts, even when aggregate benchmark accuracy appears largely unaffected. We release our code and tokenizer-verified vocabulary construction method at https://github.com/ShayanShahrabi/compress-and-forget

articles.titleCn: 压缩并遗忘：bitsandbytes量化放大了大型语言模型中的 proactive 干扰
articles.abstractCn: proactive 干扰（PI）是大型语言模型中一种已记录的失效模式，其中反复被覆盖的值的检索会随着先前覆盖的累积而退化，这与人类工作记忆中的经典现象相呼应。训练后量化（PTQ）现已成为开源权重模型的默认部署路径，但其对该失效模式的影响尚未得到测试。我们在三种架构各异的指令微调模型（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3、Phi-3.5-mini-instruct）上评估了三种精度级别（FP16、INT8、INT4/NF4，通过bitsandbytes实现），并保持检索任务固定。INT4量化在高干扰情况下显著降低了所有模型的准确率（例如，Qwen从81.0%降至68.3%），这一结果通过配对McNemar检验（$p \le 2.6 \times 10^{-6}$）和涵盖所有干扰水平的混合效应回归得到证实；通常被认为安全的INT8，在三种模型中的两种中也存在较小但确实的惩罚。这种效应仅针对语义相似的（词类型）干扰项，并在数值控制条件下改变符号，并且从机制上与INT4下相同键入侵错误的增加有关（从21.5%升至24.6%的试验，$p = 4.8 \times 10^{-7}$）。一项后续的消融实验表明，这种效应源于量化后的Transformer主干而不是输出投影层。这些结果表明，即使整体基准准确率看似基本不受影响，bitsandbytes 4位量化也可能对依赖长、可更新、语义密集上下文的应 用造成额外成本。我们在https://github.com/ShayanShahrabi/compress-and-forget上发布了我们的代码和经过tokenizer验证的词汇构建方法。

articles.title: Beyond LLM-Based Reasoning: Lightweight GNNs for Agent Failure Attribution
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) often exhibit complex failure modes, which frequently cause agents to produce incorrect outcomes. This motivates the task of Agent Failure Attribution: given a failed multi-agent trajectory, identify the faulty agents and their corresponding error types. Existing approaches predominantly rely on LLMs to perform failure attribution, either through direct prompting, fine-tuning on synthetic data or complex agentic pipelines. While effective, these methods incur substantial computational overhead due to long-context processing, expensive post-training and handcrafted workflows. Moreover, empirical evidence shows that even state-of-the-art models achieve limited accuracy on existing benchmarks, suggesting that scaling model size alone is insufficient. In this work, we revisit this task and question the necessity of such expensive generative solutions. We introduce AFANet, a lightweight graph-based framework that models interaction trajectories through step-level semantic signals and agent-level relationships. We show that with significantly fewer parameters and near-zero inference cost, AFANet (i) matches or outperforms LLM-based baselines, including fine-tuned models on in-domain benchmarks, (ii) maintains robust performance across different GNN architectures and (iii) can be further improved with inexpensive test-time adaptation on the OOD benchmark. Our results suggest that effective agent failure attribution does not require heavy LLM reasoning and a lightweight, structured approach can achieve strong performance.
articles.titleCn: 超越基于LLM的推理：用于代理故障归因的轻量级GNN
articles.abstractCn: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）常常表现出复杂的故障模式，这经常导致智能体产生错误结果。这促使了智能体故障归因任务的出现：给定一个失败的多智能体轨迹，识别出有故障的智能体及其对应的错误类型。现有方法主要依赖大型语言模型来执行故障归因，通过直接提示、在合成数据上进行微调或复杂的智能体管道。虽然有效，但这些方法由于长上下文处理、昂贵的后训练和手工工作流程而产生了巨大的计算开销。此外，实证研究表明，即使是当前最先进的模型在现有基准测试上的准确率也有限，这表明仅增加模型规模是不够的。在这项工作中，我们重新审视了这一任务，并质疑了这种昂贵生成式解决方案的必要性。我们引入了AFANet，一个轻量级的基于图的框架，该框架通过步骤级语义信号和智能体级关系来模拟交互轨迹。我们证明，凭借显著更少的参数和近零的推理成本，AFANet (i) 能够匹敌或超越基于LLM的基线，包括在领域内基准数据集上微调的模型，(ii) 在不同的图神经网络（GNN）架构中保持稳健的性能，(iii) 可以通过在OOD基准数据集上进行低成本的测试时自适应进一步改进。我们的结果表明，有效的智能体故障归因并不需要沉重的LLM推理，轻量级、结构化的方法可以实现优异的性能。

articles.title: Shared Circuits for Shared Grammar: Tracing Subject-Verb Agreement Across Languages
articles.abstract: Multilingual large language models often generalize across languages, and prior work suggests that their internal mechanisms can overlap cross-lingually. It remains unclear, however, when such sharing emerges and whether it varies with the overt realization of the same grammatical operation. We investigate this question for present-tense subject-verb agreement, a morphosyntactic process that varies substantially across languages and is only weakly expressed in English. Using activation patching and attention analysis across 29 languages and five open-source model families, we identify the attention heads causally implicated in agreement and compare these head-level signatures across languages. We find that languages with overt person/number inflection exhibit more similar agreement circuitry than non-conjugating languages, with the strongest sharing appearing when the analysis isolates recovery of the inflectional contrast itself. English provides an informative bridge case, becoming more similar to conjugating languages precisely in contexts where overt agreement is required. Finally, many implicated heads display similar attention patterns across languages, suggesting that cross-lingual overlap reflects shared functional roles as well as shared localization. Together, these results indicate that multilingual LLMs reuse partially shared computational structure for morphosyntactic agreement rather than relying on fully separate language-specific solutions.
articles.comment: 25 pages including appendices, 16 figures. Accepted to COLM 2026
articles.titleCn: 共享语法共享电路：追踪跨语言的主谓一致
articles.abstractCn: 多语言大型语言模型通常能在不同语言间泛化，而先前研究表明其内部机制可能存在跨语言的共性。然而，这种共享机制何时出现以及是否随同一语法操作的显性实现而变化，目前尚不清楚。我们针对现在时主谓一致这一形态句法过程展开研究，该过程在不同语言中差异显著，且在英语中仅以微弱形式表达。通过跨29种语言和五大开源模型家族的激活块修补和注意力分析，我们识别出与一致相关的因果注意力头，并比较了这些头级别的跨语言特征。我们发现，具有显性人称/数屈折变化的语言比非屈折语言表现出更相似的一致电路结构，当分析聚焦于屈折对比的恢复时，共享程度最为显著。英语作为一个信息丰富的桥梁案例，在需要显性一致性的语境中，其相似性恰好与非屈折语言趋同。最后，许多相关注意力头在不同语言中表现出相似的模式，表明跨语言重叠不仅反映了共享的功能角色，也体现了共享的定位特征。综合这些结果，表明多语言LLM在形态句法一致方面重用了部分共享的计算结构，而非依赖完全独立的特定语言解决方案。

articles.title: Evaluating and Explaining Prompt Sensitivity of LLMs Using Interactions
articles.abstract: The remarkable capabilities of large language models (LLMs) are often undermined by their instability. Even subtle and semantically irrelevant changes in prompts can cause dramatic fluctuations in performance, a phenomenon known as prompt sensitivity. Previous studies typically evaluate prompt sensitivity by comparing the LLM's final outputs when prompts change. However, such coarse-grained metrics fail to explain the internal reasons for prompt sensitivity. In this paper, we introduce interactions as a fine-grained tool to analyze prompt sensitivity of LLMs. Specifically, we decompose the output score of the LLM into a set of interactions. Each interaction represents a nonlinear relationship involving a set of input variables. We discover that subtle changes to prompts can trigger severe instability in interactions, even when the outputs of the LLM remain the same. To this end, we propose an Interaction-based Prompt Sensitivity (IPS) metric by quantifying changes in interactions when we introduce subtle changes to prompts. We apply the IPS metric to 50 open-source LLMs and uncover four factors that reduce the prompt sensitivity of LLMs, including supervised fine-tuning, increased model scales, dense architectures, and few-shot learning. More crucially, we discover a common mechanism by which these four factors reduce prompt sensitivity: all four factors tend to reduce the prompt sensitivity of low-order interactions (i.e., interactions involving few input variables).
articles.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). 46 pages, 48 figures
articles.titleCn: 使用交互评估和解释LLMs的提示敏感性
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的卓越能力常因不稳定性而受损。即使提示中微小的、语义上无关的变化也可能导致性能剧烈波动，这种现象被称为提示敏感性。以往的研究通常通过比较LLM在提示变化时的最终输出来评估提示敏感性。然而，这种粗粒度指标无法解释提示敏感性的内部原因。在本文中，我们引入交互作用作为分析LLM提示敏感性的细粒度工具。具体而言，我们将LLM的输出分数分解为一组交互作用。每个交互作用代表涉及一组输入变量的非线性关系。我们发现，对提示的细微变化会引发交互作用的严重不稳定性，即使LLM的输出保持不变。为此，我们通过在提示中引入细微变化时量化交互作用的变化，提出了基于交互作用的提示敏感性（IPS）指标。我们将IPS指标应用于50个开源LLM，并揭示了四个降低LLM提示敏感性的因素，包括监督微调、增加模型规模、密集架构和少样本学习。更重要的是，我们发现这四个因素降低提示敏感性的共同机制：这四个因素都倾向于降低低阶交互作用（即涉及少量输入变量的交互作用）的提示敏感性。

articles.title: DART-SD: Diamond-topology Aware Retrieval and Tuning for Self-Distillation of Multi-Turn Tool-Calling Agents
articles.abstract: Equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with multi-turn tool-calling capabilities is essential for building autonomous agents. However, progress is fundamentally limited by the reliance on full-length trajectory imitation. For tasks involving multiple order-independent sub-goals, the optimal solution space forms a vast combinatorial diamond lattice. Forcing this rich topology into monolithic trajectories causes a severe topological collapse, indiscriminately penalizing valid alternative explorations and severely degrading policy diversity. To address this, we propose DART-SD (Diamond-topology Aware Retrieval and Tuning for Self-Distillation), a novel framework that shifts the paradigm from global forcing to topology-guided localized correction. DART-SD first models the execution process as a converging Interaction-State Transition Graph (ISTG), faithfully capturing the inherent diamond topology of successful and failed exploratory paths. During autonomous rollouts, the framework identifies the Critical Topological Breakpoint (CTB) and retrieves success-supported recovery references. Finally, we introduce a progressive self-distillation paradigm through CTB-guided localized supervision, ensuring that the training loss is calculated exclusively on the generated recovery steps while strictly protecting the valid reasoning prefix from destructive gradient updates. Experiments on complex multi-turn tool-calling benchmarks demonstrate that DART-SD significantly outperforms traditional full-trajectory baselines.
articles.titleCn: DART-SD：针对多轮工具调用代理的自蒸馏，具有菱形拓扑感知检索与调优
articles.abstractCn: 为大型语言模型（LLM）配备多轮工具调用能力对于构建自主智能体至关重要。然而，进展从根本上受限于对完整轨迹模仿的依赖。对于涉及多个顺序无关子目标的任务，最优解空间形成一个庞大的组合菱形格网。将这种丰富的拓扑结构强制压缩成单一轨迹会导致严重的拓扑坍塌，无差别地惩罚有效的替代探索，并严重降低策略多样性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了DART-SD（菱形拓扑感知检索与自适应微调），这是一种将范式从全局强制转向拓扑引导的局部校正的新框架。DART-SD首先将执行过程建模为收敛的交互状态转换图（ISTG），忠实地捕捉成功和失败探索路径的固有菱形拓扑结构。在自主运行过程中，该框架识别关键拓扑断裂点（CTB），并检索成功支持的恢复参考。最后，我们通过CTB引导的局部监督引入渐进式自蒸馏范式，确保训练损失仅计算在生成的恢复步骤上，同时严格保护有效的推理前缀免受破坏性梯度更新的影响。在复杂的多轮工具调用基准测试中，实验表明DART-SD显著优于传统的完整轨迹基线。

articles.title: MissDiag: Diagnostic Evaluation of Incomplete-Knowledge Robustness in KGQA and KG-RAG
articles.abstract: Knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) and knowledge-graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (KG-RAG) aim to ground answers in explicit graph evidence, but real-world knowledge graphs are often sparse, outdated, and incomplete. Existing robustness evaluations usually report aggregate changes in answer quality after evidence is removed or perturbed, which measures sensitivity to incomplete support but leaves the source of degradation under-specified: the same score change can conflate the type of missing evidence, the response of the evaluated system, and the sensitivity of the answer-matching protocol. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{MissDiag}, a diagnostic evaluation framework for incomplete-knowledge robustness in KGQA and KG-RAG. MissDiag keeps the question and gold answer fixed while applying structurally typed missingness interventions to benchmark-provided support graphs, enabling paired comparisons that decompose robustness changes by evidence type, system response, and evaluation protocol rather than reducing them to a single aggregate score drop. Experiments across multiple system families show that incomplete-knowledge robustness is better understood as a typed degradation phenomenon than as a uniform property: answer-adjacent evidence loss produces the largest observed degradation, source-context removal is often neutral and can be beneficial, and semantic answer matching changes absolute scores while preserving the main typed degradation patterns. By transforming aggregate robustness measurement into typed diagnostic attribution, MissDiag provides a more interpretable basis for comparing, diagnosing, and stress-testing KGQA and KG-RAG systems under incomplete knowledge.
articles.titleCn: MissDiag：知识图谱问答（KGQA）和知识图谱检索增强生成（KG-RAG）中不完整知识鲁棒性的诊断评估
articles.abstractCn: 知识图谱问答（KGQA）和基于知识图谱的检索增强生成（KG-RAG）旨在将答案与明确的图谱证据相结合，但现实中的知识图谱往往是稀疏、过时且不完整的。现有的鲁棒性评估通常在移除或扰动证据后报告答案质量的总体变化，这衡量了对不完整支持的敏感性，但未能明确退化来源：相同的分数变化可能混淆了缺失证据的类型、评估系统的响应以及答案匹配协议的敏感性。为解决这一差距，我们提出了\textbf{MissDiag}，一个用于KGQA和KG-RAG中不完整知识鲁棒性的诊断评估框架。MissDiag在问题和黄金答案固定的情况下，对基准提供的支持图谱应用结构化类型的缺失干预措施，从而实现配对比较，将鲁棒性变化分解为证据类型、系统响应和评估协议，而不是简化为单一的总体分数下降。跨多个系统系列的实验表明，不完整知识的鲁棒性应被理解为一种类型化的退化现象，而不是一种均匀属性：答案相邻证据的缺失产生了最大的观测退化，来源上下文的移除通常是中性的，有时甚至有益，而语义答案匹配会改变绝对分数，但会保持主要的类型化退化模式。通过将总体鲁棒性测量转换为类型化的诊断归因，MissDiag为在知识不完整的情况下比较、诊断和压力测试KGQA和KG-RAG系统提供了更可解释的基础。

articles.title: WhiteMatter: All-to-All Cross-Layer Connections via KV Mixing
articles.abstract: In a Transformer, each layer attends to past tokens only through KV produced at its own depth, despite the presence of deeper representations during autoregressive decoding. Feedback architectures allow shallow consumer layers to attend to KV produced by deeper past-token representations, but give all consumer layers the same fixed connection patterns to source layers. We propose WhiteMatter, which connects every attention layer to the representations from all layers of each past token, with connection weights that can vary across consumer layers and adapt to the source token. For each token, a router implements these connections by mixing its $L$ layer states into $k$ KV channels that are cached for subsequent tokens; each consumer layer attends to one of the channels. The number of channels $k$ controls the KV-cache size. Setting $k<L$ reduces the cache's memory footprint. In our pretraining experiments, WhiteMatter outperforms a vanilla Transformer with 50% more layers and retains most of this gain with a 50% KV-cache compression.
articles.comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables
articles.titleCn: 白质：通过KV混合实现全对全跨层连接
articles.abstractCn: 在一个Transformer中，每一层仅通过自身深度生成的KV对过去token进行注意力，尽管在自回归解码过程中存在更深层的表示。反馈架构允许浅层消费者层关注由更深层的过去token表示生成的KV，但为所有消费者层提供相同的固定连接模式以连接到源层。我们提出了WhiteMatter，它将每一层注意力连接到每个过去token的所有层表示，连接权重可以在消费者层之间变化，并能适应源token。对于每个token，一个路由器通过将其$L$层状态混合到$k$个KV通道中来实现这些连接，这些通道被缓存以供后续token使用；每个消费者层关注其中一个通道。通道数量$k$控制KV缓存的尺寸。设置$k<L$可以减少缓存的内存占用。在我们的预训练实验中，WhiteMatter优于一个拥有50%更多层的普通Transformer，并且在使用50%的KV缓存压缩时仍能保持大部分增益。

articles.title: Building real-time digital twin instances with Function+Data Flow: user evaluation and extension for iterative pipelines
articles.abstract: Digital twins (DTs) increasingly leverage artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) pipelines, both to build real-time DTs from high-fidelity simulations and to instantiate them with historical data. However, engineering these pipelines remains largely ad-hoc: pipelines are hard to specify, validate, and reuse, with scarce dedicated tooling. Function+Data Flow (FDF) addresses this by defining a visual domain-specific language (DSL) that represents functions (ML models) explicitly, enabling their composition and reuse. We implemented FDF in DesCartes Builder, an integrated modeling environment supporting FDF-based DT synthesis and validation. In this paper, we report on an empirical user study evaluating whether FDF and DesCartes Builder can make AI-based DT development more accessible and reliable. Participants implemented a representative real-time DT prototype within DesCartes Builder, and we measured perceived usability and feature adequacy through quantitative and qualitative measures. Our results indicate that DesCartes Builder and FDF achieve a good level of usability across a broad range of potential users, and particularly for the intended audience of domain experts. The study additionally surfaces concrete strengths and areas for improvement of both the tool and the underlying FDF framework. Informed by these findings, we propose H-FDF, a Hierarchical extension of FDF supporting iterative and modular pipelines, enabling the formal specification of more complex DT pipelines such as dual training. Our findings suggest that integrated, model-driven platforms are a promising direction to transform AI-based DT engineering into a disciplined modeling practice.

articles.titleCn: 使用Function+Data Flow构建实时数字孪生实例：用户评估与迭代管道的扩展
articles.abstractCn: 数字孪生（DT）越来越多地利用人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）流程，既用于从高保真仿真中构建实时DT，也用于用历史数据实例化它们。然而，这些流程的工程化仍然很大程度上是临时的：流程难以指定、验证和重用，且专用工具匮乏。功能+数据流（FDF）通过定义一种可视化领域特定语言（DSL）来解决这个问题，该语言明确表示功能（ML模型），从而实现它们的组合和重用。我们在DesCartes Builder中实现了FDF，这是一个支持基于FDF的DT合成和验证的集成建模环境。在本文中，我们报告了一项实证用户研究，评估FDF和DesCartes Builder是否能让基于AI的DT开发更加易用和可靠。参与者们在DesCartes Builder中实现了一个代表性的实时DT原型，我们通过定量和定性措施测量了感知可用性和功能充分性。我们的结果表明，DesCartes Builder和FDF在广泛的潜在用户中达到了良好的可用性水平，尤其对于预期的领域专家受众。该研究还揭示了工具和底层FDF框架的具体优势和改进领域。基于这些发现，我们提出了H-FDF，即FDF的分层扩展，支持迭代和模块化流程，能够对更复杂的DT流程（如双重训练）进行形式化指定。我们的研究结果表明，集成化、模型驱动的平台是使基于AI的DT工程转变为规范建模实践的一个有前景的方向。

articles.title: OmniAlign: A Unified Multilingual Aligner for Word and Sentence Alignment
articles.abstract: Cross-lingual sequence alignment is fundamental for building and exploiting parallel corpora, spanning mappings from documents and sentences down to words and subwords. Existing tools, however, typically specialize in a single granularity, so practitioners often need separate systems for word- and sentence-level alignment---especially in multilingual and long-text settings. We present OmniAlign, a unified multilingual aligner that supports both word-level and sentence-level alignment with a single lightweight model. Built on an encoder-only backbone with strong long-context modeling, OmniAlign induces word alignments from contextualized token similarity matrices, and obtains document-level $m$--$n$ sentence alignments via sentence embeddings combined with dynamic programming. To balance fine-grained alignment accuracy and sentence-representation quality, we use a four-stage training pipeline: alignment-oriented continued pre-training, self-supervised learning, supervised fine-tuning on human annotations, and sentence-embedding distillation from a strong multilingual teacher. Experiments show that OmniAlign achieves highly competitive performance on both word- and sentence-alignment benchmarks and generalizes well to unseen language pairs. Surprisingly, later-stage supervised fine-tuning on short texts further improves alignment quality while retaining the long-context understanding acquired in earlier training, keeping the model robust on long-text word alignment. \normalsize {\color{blue}\textbf{Code}: https://github.com/MilkDargon/OmniAlign}\par {\color{blue}\textbf{Model}: https://huggingface.co/WPS-Qingqiu/OmniAlign}
articles.titleCn: OmniAlign：用于词对齐和句对齐的统一多语言对齐器
articles.abstractCn: 跨语言序列对齐是构建和利用平行语料库的基础，涵盖从文档和句子到单词和亚词的映射。然而，现有工具通常专注于单一粒度，因此从业者往往需要分别使用单词级和句子级对齐系统——尤其是在多语言和长文本环境中。我们提出了OmniAlign，这是一种统一的跨语言对齐器，它通过单个轻量级模型支持单词级和句子级对齐。OmniAlign基于具有强大长上下文建模能力的编码器主干，通过上下文化标记相似度矩阵诱导单词对齐，并通过句子嵌入与动态规划获得文档级m--n句子对齐。为了平衡细粒度对齐精度和句子表示质量，我们采用四阶段训练流程：面向对齐的持续预训练、自监督学习、基于人工标注的监督微调，以及从强大的多语言教师那里进行句子嵌入蒸馏。实验表明，OmniAlign在单词级和句子级对齐基准测试上取得了极具竞争力的性能，并能很好地泛化到未见过的语言对。令人惊讶的是，在短文本上进行后期监督微调进一步提高了对齐质量，同时保留了早期训练中获得的长上下文理解能力，使模型在长文本单词对齐上保持稳健。\normalsize {\color{blue}\textbf{代码}: https://github.com/MilkDargon/OmniAlign}\par {\color{blue}\textbf{模型}: https://huggingface.co/WPS-Qingqiu/OmniAlign}

articles.title: More Context, Same Budget: Dual-Bounded Relational Recall Beyond Top-K Retrieval
articles.abstract: More context does not require a larger retrieval budget. Under the same ceiling, a retrieval system can recover more of the evidence a question requires by following relationships between evidence that flat top-k ranking leaves behind. We test that proposition with Dual-Bounded Relational Recall (DBRR), which allocates a fixed retrieval budget between relevance-selected seeds and bounded graph-adjacent context, against matched flat top-k retrieval using the same relevance-ranking stage and the same maximum number of retrieval units and tokens. The outcome is complete recovery of the official HotpotQA supporting-evidence set for each question. Across 7,405 FullWiki questions, the Primary DBRR allocation increased complete supporting-evidence recovery by 23.8 percentage points over its matched flat baseline (paired risk difference 0.2377; question-level bootstrap 95% interval 0.2269 to 0.2489). It improved 1,952 questions, tied on 5,261, and harmed 192. Bridge questions drove the effect, with a 28.7-point increase; comparison questions showed a smaller 4.2-point difference. In a prespecified, evaluation-only diagnostic population, real relationships also outperformed random-neighbor and degree-preserving shuffled-graph controls. The result is straightforward: under the same context budget, complete-evidence retrieval depends not only on which items rank highest, but on how context is allocated around them. Relational allocation recovered complete evidence sets that flat top-k retrieval left incomplete.

articles.titleCn: 更多上下文，相同预算：超越Top-K检索的双边界关系召回
articles.abstractCn: 更多的上下文并不需要更大的检索预算。在相同的上限下，检索系统可以通过遵循平面top-k排名遗留的证据之间的关系，恢复更多问题所需证据。我们使用双边界关系召回（DBRR）来验证这一命题，DBRR在相关性选定的种子和有界图相邻上下文之间分配固定的检索预算，与使用相同的相关性排名阶段和相同最大检索单元和标记数的匹配平面top-k检索进行对比。结果是每个问题都完整地恢复了官方HotpotQA支持证据集。在7,405个FullWiki问题中，主要DBRR分配使其完整支持证据恢复率比匹配的平面基线提高了23.8个百分点（配对风险差异0.2377；问题级引导95%区间0.2269至0.2489）。它改进了1,952个问题，与5,261个问题持平，对192个问题造成了负面影响。桥接问题驱动了这一效果，其提高了28.7个百分点；比较问题显示出较小的4.2点差异。在一个预先指定的、仅用于评估的诊断群体中，真实关系也优于随机邻居和度保持打乱图的控制。结果很简单：在相同的上下文预算下，完整证据检索不仅取决于哪些项目排名最高，还取决于如何围绕它们分配上下文。关系分配恢复了平面top-k检索遗留不完整的完整证据集。

articles.title: Pedagogical AI in Mental Health: A Tri-Stream Fine-Tuned LLM Framework for Automated Clinical Supervision and Risk Triage
articles.abstract: Modern mental healthcare faces a critical shortage of senior supervisory oversight, leading to a "supervision gap" where novice therapists manage high-stakes risks with delayed professional feedback. This paper proposes a new framework utilizing a fine-tuned Mistral-7B-instruct model as an automated "Supervisor-in-the-Loop" system. By leveraging 106 sessions from the DAIC-WOZ dataset, the model performs a tri-stream analysis: (1) Therapeutic Alliance tracking via semantic adherence, (2) Latent risk prediction using attention-weighted analytics, and (3) Supervisory Triage via a Dynamic Clinical Urgency Index (D-CUI). Our multi-modal VAL (Visual-Acoustic-Linguistic) framework achieves 95% technique identification accuracy [95% CI: 75.1%-99.9%], alliance assessment MAE of 0.105 on a 5-point scale [95% CI: 0.059-0.151], therapeutic fidelity alpha = 0.423, and mean D-CUI of 0.370 [95% CI: 0.322-0.419]. Training converged in 105 steps with 85.2% loss reduction on a single Tesla T4 GPU. The system reduces supervisory triage latency from 72 hours to real time (~10 seconds per session), enabling proactive intervention in high-risk cases. The system addresses the cold-start problem through Bayesian priors and implements timestamp-based modality synchronization for robust multi-modal fusion.

articles.titleCn: 心理健康领域的教学型人工智能：用于自动化临床监督和风险分级的三角流微调大型语言模型框架
articles.abstractCn: 现代心理健康服务面临高级督导监督的严重短缺，导致出现"督导差距"——新手治疗师在没有及时专业反馈的情况下管理高风险风险。本文提出了一种新框架，利用经过微调的Mistral-7B-instruct模型作为自动化的"闭环督导"系统。通过利用DAIC-WOZ数据集中的106个会话，该模型执行三流分析：(1)通过语义依从性追踪治疗联盟；(2)使用注意力加权分析进行潜在风险预测；(3)通过动态临床紧急指数(D-CUI)进行督导分诊。我们的多模态VAL（视觉-听觉-语言）框架实现了95%的技术识别准确率[95%置信区间：75.1%-99.9%]，5分制联盟评估平均绝对误差为0.105[95%置信区间：0.059-0.151]，治疗忠实度α=0.423，平均D-CUI为0.370[95%置信区间：0.322-0.419]。在单个Tesla T4 GPU上训练在105步内收敛，损失降低85.2%。该系统将督导分诊延迟从72小时缩短至实时（每个会话约10秒），从而在高风险案例中实现主动干预。该系统通过贝叶斯先验解决冷启动问题，并实施基于时间戳的模态同步，以实现稳健的多模态融合。

articles.title: Tangut Word Segmentation under Extreme Resource Scarcity: Integrating Traditional Lexicons and Unlabeled Text
articles.abstract: Tangut is an extinct language whose script does not explicitly mark word boundaries. We present the first systematic study of Tangut word segmentation using 2,750 expert-annotated segments(31,893 tokens), traditional lexicons, and unlabeled text. Our framework combines a reliability-calibrated lexicon-lattice representation, explicit distributional statistics, and a lightweight character encoder pretrained with MLM. Segment-level five-fold cross-validation shows that lexical and statistical features raise CRF F1 to approximately 0.91. The full TangutEncoder reaches the highest mean F1 (0.911) and improves recall beyond the labeled training vocabulary. These results demonstrate generalization beyond the limited supervised vocabulary across thematically diverse held-out passages, while document-level transfer remains to be evaluated.
articles.titleCn: 极端资源稀缺下的藏语分词：整合传统词汇和未标记文本
articles.abstractCn: 唐古特语是一种已灭绝的语言，其文字系统没有明确标记词边界。我们利用2,750个专家标注的片段（31,893个词元）、传统词汇表和无标签文本，首次对唐古特语词段进行系统性研究。我们的框架结合了经过可靠性校准的词汇格网表示、显式的分布统计和经过MLM预训练的轻量级字符编码器。片段级别的五折交叉验证表明，词汇和统计特征将CRF F1值提升至约0.91。完整的TangutEncoder达到了最高的平均F1值（0.911），并提高了超出标注训练词汇的召回率。这些结果表明，模型在主题多样化的测试片段中实现了超越有限监督词汇的泛化能力，而文档级别的迁移学习仍需评估。

articles.title: Multimodal Rapport Estimation in Real-World HRI
articles.abstract: Evaluating interaction quality in real-world HRI is an important challenge. If interaction quality can be estimated reliably, the results can be used to improve dialogue strategies and ultimately enable robots to adapt their behavior autonomously. However, existing automatic evaluation methods have been developed primarily in controlled laboratory settings, and it remains unclear whether they can be directly applied to real-world environments, where users are free to disengage and multi-party participation may arise naturally. In this study, we investigate the automatic estimation of third-party-rated rapport scores using 62 sessions of multimodal recordings collected in a Japanese drugstore. We compare zero-shot LLMs, pretrained text, audio, and visual models, and their prediction-level fusion. The results show that, in real-world HRI, zero-shot LLMs achieve strong performance, while audio and visual models tend to provide complementary information. In particular, Gemini 2.5 Flash performs strongly as a single model, and a fusion model combining Gemini (text) with HuBERT and V-JEPA performs best overall. Further analyses showed that estimation performance varied across interaction-duration and group-size conditions. These findings suggest that rapport estimation in real-world HRI requires evaluation and model design that account for contextual variability beyond that assumed in laboratory settings.

articles.titleCn: 现实世界人机交互中的多模态融洽度估计
articles.abstractCn: 在现实世界中的人机交互（HRI）中评估交互质量是一项重要挑战。如果能够可靠地估计交互质量，这些结果可用于改进对话策略，并最终使机器人能够自主地调整其行为。然而，现有的自动评估方法主要是在受控的实验室环境中开发的，目前尚不清楚它们是否可以直接应用于现实世界环境，在这些环境中，用户可以自由地脱离交互，并且多方参与可能会自然发生。在本研究中，我们使用在日本一家药店收集的62个多模态录音会话，研究了第三方评级的融洽度分数的自动估计。我们比较了零样本大型语言模型（LLM）、预训练的文本、音频和视觉模型及其预测级融合。结果表明，在现实世界的人机交互中，零样本LLM表现出色，而音频和视觉模型倾向于提供互补信息。特别是，Gemini 2.5 Flash作为单个模型表现强劲，而结合Gemini（文本）与HuBERT和V-JEPA的融合模型整体表现最佳。进一步分析表明，估计性能在不同交互时长和群体规模条件下有所不同。这些发现表明，现实世界的人机交互中的融洽度估计需要评估和模型设计，这些设计应考虑超出实验室环境假设的上下文变化。
